title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics: A Multidimensional Multi-Physics CFD Analysis
scientific_focus: Droplet cool flames; computational fluid dynamics and thermal perturbations
objectives: Determine how weak convection, external heating, and their interaction influence initiation, oscillation, and extinction of microgravity droplet cool flames.
approach: Develop a three-dimensional OpenFOAM CFD model of n-alkane droplets with fluid dynamics, low-temperature chemistry, transport, and radiation. Validate with ISS FLEX data, then test droplet drift, imposed heat flux, and combined forcing over multiple droplet sizes and ambient conditions to map cool-flame stability.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
